crossRefs.note: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
I have hoped for your salvation, Yahweh. I have done your commandments.
I have waited for your salvation, Yahweh.
Isn’t my house so with God? Yet he has made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure, for it is…
Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.
I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, If you find my beloved, that you tell him that I am faint with love.
For I delight in God’s law after the inward man,
Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves…
But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.
I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.
Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors.
I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.
Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.
I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.
My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.
but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.

translations.web: I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh. Your law is my delight.
translations.bsb: I long for Your salvation, O LORD, and Your law is my delight.
translations.kjv: I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law is my delight.
translations.asv: I have longed for thy salvation, O Jehovah; And thy law is my delight.
